stories.title: Kroger rolls out new employee dress code across stores nationwide
stories.summary: Kroger has implemented a new uniform policy for its in-store employees across nearly 400,000 workers, replacing personal clothing with company-branded tops. This change aims to make employees more recognizable to shoppers and create a consistent appearance, with early feedback reportedly being positive. It marks the first major uniform update for Kroger in approximately a decade.
